title: Nav Graph Data
description: Canonical nav-graph store for TJBot-mobile. Generated/maintained by scripts/flows/extract-go-calls.mjs.

states.description: Map of state-id -> state record. State IDs are snake_case with domain prefix.

f.description: Source file (relative to src/ or repo root) where the state's screen component lives. Accepts the `(undeclared)` sentinel for soft-fail bootstrap (extractor synthesizes; T10-style fix is required to clear). Allows nested subdirs (e.g. src/features/device/pairing/screens/PairFoundScreen.jsx).

title.description: Human-readable label for the state, used as the mermaid node label.

g.description: nav-graph group label (used as mermaid subgraph label inside the owning domain's flow.mmd).

kind.description: Classification: 'happy' = normal happy-path screen; 'edge' = failure/recovery/cancel/timeout/validation/unauthorized — must be paired with edge_cases entry in the owning domain.meta.json.

edges.description: Directed go() transitions captured by extract-go-calls.mjs. Sorted by (from, to, file, line).

from.description: Source state id (must exist in states).

to.description: Target state id (must exist in states; validator asserts no orphans).

file.description: Source file the go() call was found in.

line.description: 1-based line number of the go() call.

groups.description: nav-graph group label -> ordered array of state ids belonging to that group.

version.description: Semver of the nav-graph data shape.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last extractor run.

sourceCommit.description: Git HEAD sha of the src/ tree the extractor ran against.

retired.description: True when the legacy go() edge collector is retained only for state documentation.
